brief.question: Can the ULan launcher set its Windows command window icon from a project-root icon.ico without disrupting the server startup?
brief.purpose: Make the command window used to run ULan display the user's custom icon.
constraints: Only edit project files in place.
Use the icon file named icon.ico supplied by the user; do not create or replace it.
Preserve the server launch behavior and existing data.
brief.done_when: The Windows launch console attempts to use the adjacent icon.ico when present, while continuing to launch normally if it is absent or unsupported; check the result with rebuild_check.
